text: The Greater Yorkville Residents Association requested amendments to the existing parking regulations on the south side of Scollard Street, west of Yonge Street, in the vicinity of the first laneway west of Yonge Street, south of Scollard Street. The intent of this amendment is to prohibit stopping within close proximity to this laneway and improve sightlines for motorists entering and exiting. Transportation Services staff have been consulted and have no objection to the proposed amendment.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Scollard Street, between a point 39.5 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 20.5 metres further west.
